hooks.name: Lint Frontend on Save
hooks.description: Runs ESLint on any frontend JS/JSX file whenever it is saved. Fails (exit non-zero) if there are lint warnings or errors, surfacing them immediately in the session.

action.command: cd "d:\Kiro AI tool\Simpleusecase\tm-frontend" ; npx eslint --max-warnings=0 $(echo $env:KIRO_FILE_PATH | Resolve-Path -Relative) 2>&1
